items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Marilyn [Miriam Matthews ] give me all that.

ctx.x: You've done a lot of research!
No, Marilyn [Miriam Matthews ] give me all that. She had it all researched, and she gave me all of that stuff. But I've got the whole history of it here, and he died up there. Cut it off a minute.

This is May 5, 1980, and this is our second session of the Oral History with Reb Spikes. Reb, I listened to the first part of the interview we did, and I have a few questions I'd like to clear up. First of all, we did not get your full name. We only got Benjamin Spikes. Tell me your full name.
